scope: Complete exact NASA standard-SA equation and inflow parity by activating ft2 after separately setting nuTilda/nu=3.

single_change.name: SpalartAllmaras_ft2_switch
single_change.initialization: Copy the reconstructed ratio-3/no-ft2 solution to time zero on the identical mesh, then add only ft2 true to SpalartAllmarasCoeffs.

falsifiable_expectation.primary: The log reports ft2 active and the run reaches the existing trend, residual, and alpha-zero symmetry thresholds.
falsifiable_expectation.drag: No target direction is assumed; compare the converged last-100 Cd with the ratio-3/no-ft2 source and hash-pinned NASA CFL3D standard-SA reference.

terminal_rule: Do not tune or extend this test. Audit at 5000 iterations. If exact standard SA still fails, retain that result and diagnose the remaining numerical/full-grid steady-mode limitation before advancing to stock SST.
